learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the exciting skills of event management by organizing a school exhibition, working as a team, and setting up an amazing project stall!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A Kaushal Mela is a grand skill exhibition! It is a special event at school where students get to showcase the amazing vocational projects they have built, like crafts, gardens, or robotics, to parents and teachers.

Organizing a big event requires a strong team. Everyone must take on a specific role. You might have a 'Team Captain' to lead, a 'Designer' to decorate the stall, and a 'Speaker' to explain the project to visitors.

A budget is a plan for your money. Before buying chart papers or colors for your stall, you must make a list of what you need and estimate the cost. The goal is to make a beautiful display without spending too much money!

Your stall should catch people's attention! Use bright posters, clear labels, and neatly arrange your project items. Be ready to greet your visitors with a smile and clearly explain what you have created and why it is useful.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Design the Mela Poster!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a blank sheet of paper and design a colorful invitation poster for your school's 'Kaushal Mela'. Make sure to include the Date, Time, Venue, and a catchy slogan like 'Come See Our Super Skills!'

quick_recap: ⭐ A Kaushal Mela is an event where students proudly display their hands-on vocational skills.
⭐ Successful events rely on teamwork, where every member has a clear and important responsibility.
⭐ Budgeting helps you plan your expenses so you do not waste money on unnecessary materials.
⭐ An attractive stall uses neat displays, clear signs, and bright colors to draw in visitors.
⭐ Good communication and a friendly smile are the best ways to present your project to guests.
